lines.text: The Israelites gather fasting in sackcloth with dust on their heads and read the Book of the Law for a quarter of the day.
God chose Abram, brought him out of Ur of the Chaldeans, and covenanted to give his descendants the land.
God divided the sea for dry ground crossing, and led them by a pillar of cloud by day and salt by night.
The people are slaves in the land God gave their fathers, and its harvest goes to their kings.
